task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Your first objective is to assure that the antique trunk is open. Then, retrieve the old key from the antique trunk inside the bedroom. And then, make absolutely sure that the wooden door is unlocked. And then, ensure that the wooden door in the bedroom is open. Once you have pulled open the wooden door, attempt to take a trip east. Next, open the screen door. Then, move east. Following that, go to the south. If you can manage that, pick-up the apple from the floor of the garden. And then, venture north. With that over with, take a trip west. Then, sit the apple on the stove. That's it!
